note: Day 1 home tea brewing (work pack B). Light and short: boil water on the home tea stove (TI_TeaStove) reading the steam, add one of two teas by the scoop, pour at the right moment. Result is weak / good / bitter. Every brew still gives a cup and a rest bonus, so nothing is wasted; abandoning before the leaves go in returns them. Deterministic, no random rolls; TeaSim.cs mirrors simulate().

steam.label: 壺口微煙
steam.hint: 壺底冒出細如蝦眼的小泡

steam.label: 一沸・魚目
steam.hint: 泡如魚眼，壺口一縷細白煙

steam.label: 二沸・連珠
steam.hint: 邊緣湧泉連珠，白煙成束

steam.label: 三沸・騰波
steam.hint: 水面翻滾，壺蓋輕跳，煙勢大

teas.label: 青溪野茶

describe.weak: 湯色淺黃，入口只有水味
describe.good: 湯色金黃，山野清香回甘
describe.bitter: 湯色發暗，苦澀壓住了香氣

teas.hint: 野茶耐泡，水要二沸，三匙恰好

teas.label: 梅花茶

describe.weak: 梅香若有似無，湯淡如水

teas.hint: 梅花嬌嫩，魚目時就該投茶，兩匙即可

advice.early: 出湯太早，多等幾息再倒
advice.cold: 水溫不夠，茶葉沒有舒展，看到魚目再投茶
advice.late: 出湯太晚，茶葉悶久就苦
advice.hot: 水太滾，嫩葉燙傷，火關小或早點投茶
